title: Sabuwar sigar Kyber 0.29
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Kyber 0.29 ta sauƙaƙa girka tsarin sarrafawa kai-tsaye, ta ƙara bayyana hoto sosai, kuma ta shirya aiki a ƙarin muhallai.
html:
Kyber 0.29: ƙarin isa, ƙarin inganci, ƙarin iko

Kyber 0.29 ta sauƙaƙa girka tsarin sarrafawa kai-tsaye, ta ƙara fayyace hoto sosai, kuma tana aiki a ƙarin muhallai. Goyon bayan WebSocket na asali ya faɗaɗa isarta a cikin hanyoyin sadarwar kamfanoni. Tsarin sarrafa hoto na 4:4:4 yana kiyaye kowane ɗan ƙaramin bayani a ainihin girman allo, yayin da sababbin damarmakin ɗaukar hoto a ƙananan na'urori suka buɗe ƙofa ga Raspberry Pi da na'urorin gefen hanyar sadarwa. Haka kuma, wannan sigar ta kawo tubalan farko na gudanar da tarin injunan Kyber masu yawa.

Ga abin da hakan ke nufi a aikace.

Ƙarin isa: yanzu Kyber tana aiki a hanyoyin sadarwar da a da suke toshe ta

Idan hanyar sadarwa ta ƙi

A tsarin da aka saba, Kyber tana haɗuwa ta hanyar QUIC, wani tsarin sadarwa na zamani da aka gina don sauri. Wannan na daga cikin dalilan da ya sa Kyber ke amsawa nan take. Matsalar ita ce, wasu hanyoyin sadarwar kamfanoni suna toshe QUIC, ko kuma ba sa karɓar ta kwata-kwata. Ga mai aikin da ke ƙoƙarin isa ga wata na'ura da ke bayan katangar tsaro mai tsauri, hakan na nufin babu haɗi ko kaɗan.

Kyber ta samo mafita ta WebSocket

Kyber 0.29 ta ƙara cikakkiyar hanyar madadi ta WebSocket, wani ma'auni da kusan kowace hanyar sadarwa ke karɓa. Idan aka toshe QUIC, Kyber za ta koma kan WebSocket, kuma haɗin zai wuce. Ya ɗan fi jinkiri kaɗan, amma za ku ci gaba da kasancewa a haɗe. Hanyar sarrafawarku za ta ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe, ko wace irin dokar sashen fasahar sadarwa ce.

Yanzu goyon bayan WebSocket ya zama na asali a cikin manhajar Kyber ta kwamfuta. A bayan fage, sigar burauza da ta kwamfuta suna amfani da lambar haɗi ɗaya, don haka duk wani ci gaba yana isa gare su duka a lokaci guda.

Ƙarin inganci: kowane ɗigon hoto, kowane launi, a kowace na'ura

Dalilin da ya sa allon nesa ke yawan yin dishi-dishi

Don rage amfani da bayanai, yawancin tsarin yaɗa bidiyo suna adana launi a ƙaramin inganci fiye da haske. A fim, ba wanda ke lura. Amma a allon aiki, kowa yana gani: ƙananan akwatunan teburin lissafi suna wahalar karantawa, launukan tambarin kamfani suna sauyawa, siraran layukan samfuran 3D kuma suna cakuɗewa da juna.

Cikakken launin 4:4:4 a ainihin girman allonku

Kyber 0.29 tana sarrafa bidiyo da cikakken launin 4:4:4, wato kowane ɗigon hoto yana riƙe ainihin launinsa. Rubutu yana nan a fili, fuskokin manhajoji suna nan fayau, launuka kuma suna nan daidai, har ma a na'urorin da kayan zanensu ba za su iya sarrafa 4:4:4 da kansu ba.

Haka kuma Kyber ta daina rage girman manyan allo. Har zuwa yanzu, sarrafa bidiyo ta manhaja tana rage duk abin da ya fi faɗin ɗigon hoto 1920 zuwa Full HD. Wannan iyaka ta tafi. Yanzu kwamfuta mai allon 4K tana yaɗawa a 4K.

Excel ɗinku zai ci gaba da zama mai karantuwa, a duk inda yake aiki.

Ƙarin dandamali: sarrafawa kai-tsaye, har a kan Raspberry Pi

Yanzu sabar Kyber za ta iya ɗaukar hotuna ta GStreamer, kayan aikin da aka fi dogaro da shi wajen sauti da bidiyo a ƙananan na'urori da dama. Wannan sigar kuma ta kawo zaɓin kayan aiki mafi wayo, ingantaccen sarrafa firam, da rage lokacin sarrafa bidiyo, tare da gyaran matsalar tsayawar manhaja a katunan zane na Intel Arc.

Gaba ɗaya, waɗannan sauye-sauyen suna ba mu damar daidaita Kyber sosai don Raspberry Pi da sauran ƙananan na'urori masu ƙarancin amfani da wuta. Hakan yana da muhimmanci ga fannin mutum-mutumi, jirage marasa matuƙi, da kowace na'urar gefen hanyar sadarwa inda yaɗa bidiyo na Kyber mai ƙarancin jinkiri ke buƙatar aiki a kan kayan aiki masu sauƙi. Ba da daɗewa ba za a fitar da kunshin Raspberry Pi na musamman a GitLab.

Ƙarin iko: tubalan gudanar da tarin injunan Kyber masu yawa

Wata tashar gudanarwa na nan tafe, wadda za ta ba ƙungiyoyi damar gani da sarrafa kowace na'urar Kyber daga wuri ɗaya. Kyber 0.29 ta shimfiɗa harsashin hakan.

Bugun zuciya ga kowace na'ura

Wani sabon wakili yana ba kowace na'ura mai ɗauke da Kyber damar aika ƙaramin sigina kusan duk bayan daƙiƙa 10 don sanar da cewa tana kan layi kuma a shirye take. Idan siginar ta tsaya, za ku san cewa na'urar ba ta samuwa. Babu hasashe, babu bincike da hannu.

Zaman aiki da ba ya katsewa

Yanzu haɗin da aka tantance yana samun musayar alamar shiga da sabunta ta kai-tsaye. Alamar shiga tana aiki kamar takardar izinin wucewa ta dijital ta wucin gadi. Yanzu Kyber tana sabunta ta a bayan fage, don haka zaman aiki mai tsaro yana ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe ba tare da an sake neman masu amfani su shiga ba.

Shiga nan take ta hanyoyin kyber://

Yanzu Kyber na da tsarin hanyar haɗi na kanta. Danna hanyar kyber:// a burauza, a imel ko a dashibod, sai manhajar kwamfuta ta buɗe kai-tsaye a kan na'urar da ta dace.

Sauƙin girkawa a macOS

Yanzu sabar Kyber ta macOS tana zuwa a matsayin cikakken kunshi. Ya fi sauƙin girkawa kuma ya fi sauƙin rarrabawa a tarin kwamfutocin Mac. Abin da ke tafe: cikakken kunshi mai sa hannun tsaro, wanda macOS za ta amince da shi tun daga farko.

Sauran ingantawa da gyare-gyare

  • Sauti: manhajar sauti ta Opus ta koma sigar 1.6.1.
  • Tsaro: OIDC, ma'aunin da ke bayan shiga sau ɗaya, yanzu yana goyon bayan tantance masu karɓa na zaɓi. Kyber za ta iya tabbatar da cewa an fitar da alamar shiga ne don Kyber ba don wata manhaja ba.
  • Takardun shaida: yanzu Kyber tana duba haɗin tsaro bisa jerin takardun shaida da tsarin aikin kwamfutarku ya amince da su.
  • Manhajar yanar gizo: kulle alamar linzami yanzu yana aiki daidai a wasannin da ke ɓoye alamar.
  • VLC: fasalin ma'ajiyar bidiyo ta wucin gadi yanzu yana aiki tare da VideoToolbox, mai fassara bidiyo na kayan aiki na Apple.
  • Dogaro: fita mafi tsafta idan babu allo, rufe zaman aiki cikin sauri, gyaran matsalar haɗa lamba a GCC 16, da rage yawan saƙonni a bayanan ayyuka.

Samu Kyber 0.29

Kyber 0.29 ta fito yanzu. Duk abin da kuke buƙata don farawa yana nan.
